description: Return a link to the Stripe billing portal for the signed-in person, where they can change their card, download invoices, or cancel a subscription. Charges nothing and changes nothing on its own: it returns a link the person must open themselves. Requires `login`.

approval_id.description: Only on the second call: the approval_id from the APPROVAL NEEDED reply, once the account owner approved it. Same arguments as the first call.

name: get_billing_portal_url
